a_woree_evaluation_would_have_to_measure: a repeated, instrument-matched baseline before any exposure, in a form that can move in a profoundly impaired child (growth-scale or raw-score forms rather than standard scores); no measurement of the scatter of an untreated interval in WOREE is established here (the repository's series have one timepoint per patient; no wider search was run)
a pharmacodynamic anchor: none exists for any WWOX-directed intervention (CLAIM 046), so engagement of the intended target cannot be shown at all
one prespecified endpoint with a rescue or withdrawal rule written before the observation window opens
survival, reported beside whatever endpoint is chosen
seizures only as a separate, declared family: a countable fraction, a diary or agreed reconstruction rule, and the seizure-free stratum reported apart (it is prognostic, not a treatment effect)
and_could_not_claim: disease modification or developmental benefit: the developmental-delay row of the one WOREE series reporting a response is identical in every column and two of the three responders had died
that seizure control protects development (CLAIM 031 forbids counting any symptomatic outcome as disease modification)
benefit from a pharmacodynamic move, a global impression or an own-baseline comparison
any effect smaller than the instrument's own untreated scatter

the word protection: in the human precedents read for this frame none measured the preservation of a function that would otherwise have been lost; the repository's mouse rescue studies are outside this frame and the scope of 'this corpus' is not defined, so no wider negative is established here

must_never: No score, rank, probability or blended index. 'Non-dominated' would be a statement about visible dimensions, never a number.
No dose, route, schedule, course or paediatric suitability. Accessibility of a drug, diet or supplement does not prove paediatric suitability.
A computational prediction is not DATO. No engine was run for this card.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE and is never promoted to WWOX evidence.
A missing hit is not proof of absence.
Symptomatic benefit is not slowing of disease; the word 'protection' is not licensed by any evidence on this card.
Where CLAIM 011 has been narrowed, 'dose-dependent' does not stand.
Nothing here is medical advice; it supports discussion with a treating clinical team and never substitutes for one.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: UNKNOWN: no WOREE-relevant endpoint is supported for this class
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: none in a WWOX system; the class evidence comes from genetic mTOR-pathway reduction in a Tsc1 model (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE)
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: the infant record is in tuberous sclerosis, an mTOR-driven disease; it does not transfer to WOREE

p4_roadmap_fields.evidence_pro_contra: Visible: infant adverse-effect record and the monitoring items the authors name. Absent: any benefit signal in WOREE.
p4_roadmap_fields.identity: Sirolimus, mTOR-inhibitor class; no formulation, dose, trough target or schedule is carried.
p4_roadmap_fields.indication_and_transfer: Origin: tuberous sclerosis infants (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). Bridge to WOREE: not established.
p4_roadmap_fields.next_measure: Does the blocked WWOX/mTOR paper (full text unread) report a direction of mTOR activity in a WWOX-deficient system?
p4_roadmap_fields.novelty_for_woree: Not found in the research for a WWOX-deficient system at this card's depth. The mTOR/autophagy stubs and the blocked paper are an owed read (FT-074; DIS-37 revival trigger).
p4_roadmap_fields.paediatrics_and_interactions: A paediatric record exists for this class in another disease; it is not an authorisation for this one and not a suitability statement. Interactions: UNKNOWN.
p4_roadmap_fields.path_and_objective: Declared BENEFICIO_PRECOCE for this card because only the safety record is visible; the pathway rationale belongs to the deep-recovery path (scientist-a's cards), which this card does not enter.
p4_roadmap_fields.sources: R3 note 1.5 (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE): in 21 infants with tuberous sclerosis «All 21 had at least one adverse effect», mainly haematological and metabolic, no grade 4 or 5 and no discontinuation for an adverse effect; in ten neonatal-unit infants all had raised triglycerides; an infant spontaneous-report reporting ratio the authors call hypothesis-generating. The statement that sirolimus hyperlipidaemia is dose-dependent is a literature claim not shown in the infant cohort (R3 note section 5); no dose-response claim is carried here.
p4_roadmap_fields.status: ASTENSIONE. Missing datum: a direction of mTOR activity in a WWOX system and any WOREE endpoint.
p4_roadmap_fields.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. Clinical census 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven unfiltered queries on ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the one WOREE record is an observational registry and natural-history study. Its own caution binds this card: «A missing hit does not prove that no study exists.» An NCT number proves neither recruitment nor first dosing.
p4_roadmap_fields.value_added: Shows that an infant safety record can exist while the benefit axis is empty, so safety visibility is not candidacy.
p4_roadmap_fields.verification_scope: R3 readings: blind locator audit OWED (declared in that note). This card: audit OWED.

evidence_against: SPECIFICITY FAILED: lithium suppressed the provoked seizure in all three genotypes, wild type included (Figure 7d; entries 0, 22).

The causal attribution to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone; the paper's own Discussion names lithium's other documented actions, including Wnt/beta-catenin-dependent effects (entry 3). Lithium acts on many targets besides GSK3beta.

The only cell-line source (Wang 2012, PMID 22193544) reports Ser9 phosphorylation unchanged during retinoic-acid differentiation of SH-SY5Y cells, while WWOX rose (entry 5): that is a WWOX-gain, differentiation context, not a WWOX-loss measurement, and must not be read as a knockdown result; the knockdown experiment of that paper measured Tau phosphorylation (entry 8), not Ser9.
Direction conflict (INFERENZA): beta-catenin stabilisation by lithium would push an axis that is already raised in WWOX-loss organoids (map record R-04, axis M5; card P4-D-02).
Different control groups and schedules for lithium and ethosuximide inside one figure (entries 27, 28): the two drugs are not compared on equal terms.
A clinical anticonvulsant effect would be symptomatic: CLAIM 031 states that seizure control does not buy development.

mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Symptomatic seizure suppression in a provoked-seizure assay; not WWOX-specific (wild type responds). Not deep recovery; WWOX function would remain lost. Track B: no allele-specific datum.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class

input.no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card. Every locator is an existing entry of the deep-dive manifests PMID32000863.json and PMID22193544.json; the figure statements are those entries' own.
not_known: Whether lithium does anything in a Wwox-deficient system that it does not do in a wild-type one (the one experiment that tested it answered no).
Whether lithium moves GSK3beta Ser9 phosphorylation or kinase activity in a Wwox-null brain: lithium's effect on the Ser9 readout was not measured in this system.

Whether GSK3beta abundance or Ser9 state tracks activity here: abundance and activity are dissociable in this very system (S9-independent inhibition), and no kinase-activity assay exists in a WWOX system.
Whether the null-genotype hypersusceptibility is a driver of the developmental phenotype or an amplifier on a malformed brain (entry 6).
Whether the wild-type response is floor-limited in a way that hides a genotype difference.
Any allele-specific datum (Q230P class or splice allele): none exists for lithium.
Net direction on the Wnt axis: lithium stabilises beta-catenin, and WWOX-loss organoids show nuclear beta-catenin already raised (card P4-D-02).

p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN beyond non-specific seizure suppression; direction on the Wnt axis possibly adverse (INFERENZA).
p4_card.identity: Lithium (the salt used in the mouse experiment: lithium chloride; the clinical compound class is lithium carbonate), used in the one WWOX experiment as a tool inhibitor of GSK3beta. Map records R-04 (repurposing) and N-02 (negative translation) describe the same candidate and are linked to this one card.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Symptomatic seizure suppression is the only endpoint ever tested in a WWOX system; it is non-specific (wild type responds equally). A WWOX-specific disease-modifying rationale is not supported by the primary data. Transfer to the reference genotype: not established.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: GSK3beta (among many); claimed: inhibits a kinase de-repressed by WWOX loss; the de-repression is read from a single Ser9 phosphorylation blot; the attribution of the seizure effect to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone.
p4_card.next_measurement: A provoked-seizure arm with an explicit, tested null versus wild-type contrast and the interaction reported, or a different GSK3beta inhibitor under the same design; and a kinase-activity or substrate-phosphorylation readout in a Wwox-null system. Until then no genotype-specific claim is available.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied once (Cheng 2020, one laboratory, one experiment). Not new; the question is whether the result means what it was read as meaning.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A (allele-blind); not deep recovery.
p4_card.pharmacology: Approved compound (class level, from map record R-04) with a narrow therapeutic index and monitoring needs; CNS exposure is not in doubt. Nothing here is a statement about exposure in WWOX-DEE.

abstention_card.an_abstention_is_a_result: The roadmap states it; this card names what would end it.
abstention_card.missing_datum: Whether Q230P synthesis is translation-limited and whether the variant protein folds: a non-allele-specific boost raises both alleles, so the sign of the benefit depends on a folding fate that is unknown. Never attempted in any WWOX system.
abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA: parked, not refuted (TX-002, DL-MOL-004); no dedicated query for this card.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.

disease_assertions.endpoint: WWOX protein detectable by Western blot (lysate fraction not separated)
disease_assertions.locator: CLAIM 019, paragraph 'DATO FUNZIONALE, CAUSA NON RISOLTA'; PAPER 041
disease_assertions.measured_result_note: Transcript comparable to reference lines, protein band not detected. One membrane, one exposure, one donor line, no healthy fibroblast control, no densitometry, no n. No proteasome inhibitor, chaperone, synthesis, solubility or half-life measurement exists; the authors leave open impaired translation or premature degradation. The endpoint is 'mRNA normal + protein not detected', not a post-translational mechanism.
disease_assertions.source: claim_registry_current CLAIM 019 (functional source: PAPER 041, a single-laboratory study)

disease_assertions.note: The only human WWOX-deficient transcript datum in which PDK is HIGHER; the two human neural transcript systems give PDK1 lower in sign only (inside the single-gene null). The isoform is unspecified in the sentence quoted, but the paper's Methods qPCR list names PDK1. Results name this condition (normoxia and normoglycaemia); the Discussion says PDK mRNA also rose in hypoxia-hyperglycaemia while the Results list for that condition names only PFK1 and PKM2 (internal inconsistency not resolved). n of the qPCR panel not stated in the sentence read. The PDK transcript sign therefore differs between a non-neural human line (up) and two neural transcript systems (not higher, lower only in sign): a cell-type contrast that is confounded (line, method, depth of silencing) and is not a finding about WWOX.

drug_assertions.locator: abstract: DCA decreased plasma lactate by about 50 percent, glucose production by 7 to 9 percent and plasma glucose by 9 to 14 percent in both subjects with cirrhosis and control subjects; the decreases did not differ between groups (the null is the group difference); clearance about a third of controls
drug_assertions.note: Acute single infusion in 7 adults with cirrhosis and 6 healthy volunteers: a modest fall in glucose production and plasma glucose in BOTH groups; the only null is cirrhosis against control. Isotope-dilution human glucose kinetics, adult, acute; it does not transfer to a hypoglycaemic infant-stage brain-disease model, and it shows the lever lowering glucose in people who were not hypoglycaemic.
drug_assertions.source: dichloroacetate, human adults, Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics in cirrhosis 1999 (PMID 10546922), abstract; NOT WWOX EVIDENCE

context.disease_id: primary fibroblasts from patients with PDC-E1 mutations and five healthy subjects (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE)

drug_assertions.endpoint: glucose consumption and lactate production with and without DCA, patient against control cells
drug_assertions.locator: abstract: in pyruvate dehydrogenase complex-deficient cells DCA decreased average glycolysis by 29%, with no significant effect on control cells, and lactate production did not change in either cell type
drug_assertions.note: The response to the PDK inhibitor depended on a pre-existing PDH defect: no significant effect in control cells (six patient lines and five control subjects; the 29% average excludes one patient line with an unusual splicing mutation). It supplies the design of the discriminating experiment (a genotype-by-inhibitor interaction on glucose-derived acetyl-CoA flux), with a precedent for what a responder looks like.
drug_assertions.source: dichloroacetate, human fibroblasts, Simpson 2006 (PMID 16765624), abstract; NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.target_id: glycolytic flux and lactate production in cultured fibroblasts

evidence_against: Three exploratory transcript tests in the one knockout organoid dataset are negative for the chain.
The paper does not name dichloroacetate or any PDH/PDK element.

IT7 P3/P1 (exploratory, independently verified): the six-gene glycolysis/lactate module was inconclusive in an independent WWOX-loss contrast (P47T hippocampus, p 0.060, inside its null; PDK1 lower by -0.08) and the network routes showed no added value for ranking compounds (signature route: not detected, not excluded); this card's compound was outside that comparison by design. A computational result, not efficacy data.

mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: qualified by several curated cards: P4-E-03; P4-I-01
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class

input.no_new_reading: No paper was newly read in full for these cards. The Lucas-Clarke reading is scientist-a's (receipt FTR-20261026-42909904-01); the compound statements are abstract-level PubMed reads and registry-database retrievals (lucas_clarke_followup_20261026/).
not_known: Whether PDH activity or pyruvate oxidation is altered in any WWOX-deficient human neural system.
Whether pyruvate was tested in the fly metabolomics (MTBLS12344 not publicly retrievable).
Whether the Ldh rise diverts pyruvate from oxidation at all.

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

against: The study measured nothing in this branch.
PDK1 transcript is down and the PDK/PDH set is not different from chance in the human knockout organoid (exploratory transcripts).
The sima:GFP reporter (the authors' HIF1alpha homologue) is unchanged in one genotype pair; the authors name Atf4 rather than sima as primarily responsible.
Known neurotoxicity concern for the main compound; the ketogenic hypothesis dominates it on safety.

IT7 P3/P1 (exploratory, independently verified): the six-gene glycolysis/lactate module was inconclusive in an independent WWOX-loss contrast (P47T hippocampus, p 0.060, inside its null; PDK1 lower by -0.08) and the network routes showed no added value for ranking compounds (signature route: not detected, not excluded); this card's compound was outside that comparison by design. A computational result, not efficacy data.
for: The Lucas-Clarke Ldh rise is the kind of change that could draw pyruvate away from oxidation (logic only).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No datum from any WWOX system at the activity or flux level.

p4_card.identity: Dichloroacetate (PDK inhibitor, phase 3 per Open Targets for congenital lactic acidosis, no US label found) and research PDK inhibitors (AZD7545, VER-246608). Devimistat is NOT counted: DGIdb gives it no action type on PDK2-4.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF a pyruvate-oxidation block exists in WWOX-deficient neural cells. Nothing in the Lucas-Clarke study tests that; the branch logic (a raised Ldh pulls pyruvate away from oxidation) is indirect by two steps.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: PDK1-4 (HGNC:8809-8812; UniProt Q15118, Q15119, Q15120, Q16654), NOT PDPK1 (HGNC:8816); direction: release PDH from inhibitory phosphorylation; context: no WWOX system.
p4_card.next_measurement: IT7 P6 2026-10-29: the decisive measurement is unchanged and is specified in card I01 (PDHA1 Ser293 phosphorylation, activity and tracer, genotype by inhibitor); read PDK1, LDHA, LDHB, HK2, SLC2A1 and BNIP3 transcripts beside it; no computational ranking selects the compound arm. IT8 P3 2026-10-29: the probe of the genotype-by-inhibitor arm is a PDK inhibitor of nanomolar potency, not dichloroacetate (see card I01). The same discriminating assay as the ketogenic hypothesis, one step finer: PDH activity and labelled-glucose fate in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic human neural cells. If PDH activity and pyruvate fate are normal, HYP-20260709-05 stays parked with a stronger negative; if pyruvate oxidation is blocked, this card and the ketogenic hypothesis are both reopened.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NOT NEW: HYP-20260709-05 and N-08 already hold this candidate (parked; dominated by the ketogenic hypothesis; peripheral-neuropathy flag).
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.
p4_card.pharmacology: Dichloroacetate: weak in the retrieved enzyme and cell assays; no label found; spontaneous-report counts exist but are not rates. Research PDK inhibitors: enzyme tools only.
question_history: IT7 P6 (2026-10-29): the six-gene module did not transfer decisively to an independent WWOX-loss contrast and the network routes showed no added value and the signature route was not detected, not excluded (loop_demonstration_it7_p6_20261029/README.md; P3 numbers independently verified). Status, F/C/P position and the premise are unchanged.

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: Statements marked INFERENZA, including every statement about what a compound would do in WWOX-deficient tissue, are OWED a blind audit by another actor.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Disease-side fly rows carry verbatim locators in the manifest (104 entries; entries 31, 49, 89, 94 SUPPORTED by a blind audit, entry 95 narrowed after an OVERSHOOT finding); the compound statements are abstract-level and unaudited.
scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: No independent replication of any fly row is held; the organoid rows are one laboratory's deposit.

external_not_wwox_evidence: ChEMBL curated mechanism and activity rows for dichloroacetate
DGIdb PDK2-4 rows
Open Targets phase 3 candidate

p4_card.state_of_known_roads: HYP-20260709-05, N-08, DL-MECH-020 (HIF1A to PDK to PDH chain).
p4_card.value_added: Keeps the pyruvate branch SEPARATE from what the paper measured and records that three exploratory transcript tests are negatives that do not show normal PDH or lactate.

cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: none measured in WWOX-deficient human neurons at the activity level.
cellular_context.limits: The transcript negatives are exploratory and do not show PDH activity or lactate are normal; the HIF1A-to-PDK-to-PDH step is unmeasured in any WWOX-deficient human neural system.
cellular_context.target_expression: PDK isoforms are expressed in brain; the WWOX-dependent level is UNKNOWN.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: A WWOX-linked PDH readout that a PDK inhibitor moves: PDH activity (or PDHA1 serine phosphorylation) and pyruvate fate (labelled glucose into acetyl-CoA, citrate, lactate) in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic human neural cells; only then a functional endpoint.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX at the activity level. The Lucas-Clarke study measured no pyruvate, PDH, PDK or flux. In the human knockout organoid PDK1 is lower in sign only (inside the single-gene null, p about 0.30; not a demonstrated decrease), the PDK/PDH set is not different from chance and the LDH-to-PDH ratio is not shifted (transcripts).
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Fly study with no measurement in this branch; transcripts from one organoid deposit; compound statements are database rows.

p4_roadmap_fields.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF a pyruvate-oxidation block exists in WWOX-deficient neural cells. Nothing in the Lucas-Clarke study tests that; the branch logic (a raised Ldh pulls pyruvate away from oxidation) is indirect by two steps.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: A WWOX-linked PDH readout that a PDK inhibitor moves: PDH activity (or PDHA1 serine phosphorylation) and pyruvate fate (labelled glucose into acetyl-CoA, citrate, lactate) in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic human neural cells; only then a functional endpoint.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX at the activity level. The Lucas-Clarke study measured no pyruvate, PDH, PDK or flux. In the human knockout organoid PDK1 is lower in sign only (inside the single-gene null, p about 0.30; not a demonstrated decrease), the PDK/PDH set is not different from chance and the LDH-to-PDH ratio is not shifted (transcripts).
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Fly study with no measurement in this branch; transcripts from one organoid deposit; compound statements are database rows.

abstention_card.an_abstention_is_a_result: The roadmap states it; this card names what would end it.
abstention_card.missing_datum: A baseline: no aberrant-to-normal transcript ratio exists for any WWOX splice allele in any tissue, no WWOX splice allele has had its RNA examined with an NMD inhibitor, and no intragenic precedent exists. Without a baseline an efficacy endpoint has no denominator.
abstention_card.search_record: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA, bounded to the set searched. 'antisense' and 'oligonucleotide' were 0 in the 20-record splice-relevant census set (19 of 20 read at abstract depth; known-roads § 2.8, 2026-10-20), not across every WWOX record: the repository holds WWOX papers that use an antisense construct (PMID 19366691) or a morpholino knockdown (PMID 25649963), neither a splice-switching correction arm. A later three-query PubMed leg with a passing positive control (analysis/splice_allele_rna_evidence_20260922.md) supports the absence of an aberrant-to-normal ratio; PubMed zeros are not re-runnable offline. Of the 20 records three measured a transcript from a splice allele.

candidate.name: Splice-switching ASO for a canonical acceptor allele

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
NO_MATCH_FOUND is not 'does not exist'; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA is not MAI_TENTATO.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations or exposures of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA, bounded to the set searched. 'antisense' and 'oligonucleotide' were 0 in the 20-record splice-relevant census set (19 of 20 read at abstract depth; known-roads § 2.8, 2026-10-20), not across every WWOX record: the repository holds WWOX papers that use an antisense construct (PMID 19366691) or a morpholino knockdown (PMID 25649963), neither a splice-switching correction arm. A later three-query PubMed leg with a passing positive control (analysis/splice_allele_rna_evidence_20260922.md) supports the absence of an aberrant-to-normal ratio; PubMed zeros are not re-runnable offline. Of the 20 records three measured a transcript from a splice allele.

disease_assertions.endpoint: WWOX protein detectable by Western blot (lysate fraction not separated)
disease_assertions.locator: CLAIM 019, paragraph 'DATO FUNZIONALE, CAUSA NON RISOLTA'; PAPER 041
disease_assertions.measured_result_note: Transcript comparable to reference lines, protein band not detected. One membrane, one exposure, one donor line, no healthy fibroblast control, no densitometry, no n. No proteasome inhibitor, chaperone, synthesis, solubility or half-life measurement exists; the authors leave open impaired translation or premature degradation. The endpoint is 'mRNA normal + protein not detected', not a post-translational mechanism.

drug_assertions.endpoint: total variant protein, class-I HDAC-inhibitor comparator (butyrate) at the same applied level
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Mutant total protein about 1.05 of untreated control, no significance mark (three experiments); the text lists only the phenylbutyrate class and two osmolytes as stabilising. On wild type the same comparator gave a scattered, unmarked value near 1.95. The comparator was more potent than the phenylbutyrate class on class-I HDAC enzymes in one ChEMBL document but weaker on HDAC1 in a third that also lists the sodium salt, so that premise is document-dependent; it does not engage HDAC6 at the applied level; no pan-HDAC or HDAC6-selective arm exists in this paper. A measured null in a cell that is not comparable.

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Mutant total protein about 1.8 (sorbitol) and about 2.35 (trehalose) fold of control, significance marks printed; also raised in yeast by a second assay. Both act at high osmolyte levels, so an osmotic effect is not separated from chaperoning; the effect is on wild type as well.

context.genotype: five variants (P335L, R406H, P480L, G544D, G544V)
context.species: mouse neurons, lentiviral human cDNA in a conditional null background

drug_assertions.endpoint: synaptotagmin-1 antibody uptake (function of the same protein), 4-phenylbutyrate arm
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Mutant total protein sits at about 4 to 8 percent of wild type in four of five variants and rises only about 1.05 to 1.65 fold with the class; the soluble fraction roughly doubles (soluble pool about 2 to 4 fold, reader arithmetic); function reaches or exceeds the untreated wild-type range for three of the four low-protein variants (R406H about 44 against about 55 does not; the fifth variant, P335L, has about 65 percent protein and little baseline deficit). The soluble-pool figures combine panels with different loading normalisers and carry a reader error of about plus or minus 10 percent of axis, and fold values near 1.05 are not separable from 1.0. Quantity and function are not proportional (read-out saturation not excluded; the authors report near-wild-type expression in neurons, not overexpression, and a pixel-threshold read-out); a steady-state deficit of about 12 to 25 fold is only about 1.5 to 3 fold explained by the measured turnover.
drug_assertions.source: Guiberson 2018 (PMID 30266908), Figures 3, 4 and 6 read in IT5 P8; NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.target_id: STXBP1:Munc18-1 vesicle-recycling read-out in Munc18-1-null neurons expressing variants

context.disease_id: phenylketonuria model (not WWOX)

drug_assertions.endpoint: liver mutant enzyme protein and plasma phenylalanine (function read-out)
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Enzyme protein rose toward wild type with acetylated HSP90 up; plasma phenylalanine fell about 44 percent from sham yet stayed about three times wild type; two sham animals against three treated; a higher exposure level caused kidney enlargement, ascites and deaths; no turnover measurement supports the authors' degradation reading. Shows that a cytosolic mutant enzyme can respond to an HDAC6 lever, which butyrate does not engage.
drug_assertions.source: PMID 41274966 (R1 reading, manifest of 2026-10-22); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.target_id: PAH:phenylalanine hydroxylase protein, p.Phe263Ser (cytosolic enzyme), selective HDAC6 inhibitor (comparator lever, not the phenylbutyrate class)

Class-I HDAC action does not reproduce the soluble mutant gain, but that does not exclude HDAC6 or transcription-linked effects.
Observed gains also apply to wild type and are small against a deficit of tens of fold.

mission_dimensions.route_note: qualified by one curated card: P4-A-01; Track is read only from the card(s) that state it - P4-A-01 state(s) a route and no Track (written before Track was qualified)

input.no_new_reading: Original cards: no paper was opened. IT5 P8 revision: the Munc18-1 paper's mutant panel of Supplementary Figure 12a, Figures 3 and 6 and the chemical-chaperone passages were re-read (a re-read receipt is staged under receipt_staging/scientist-b and is not yet in the ledger); HDAC potencies were pulled from ChEMBL keyless; the other sources are the repository's own receipted notes.
not_known: Where the Q230P protein is lost: never made, made and cleared, made and insoluble, made and epitope-invisible, or truncated. No fractionation, inhibitor, synthesis or half-life datum exists for the exact variant.

Whether any recovered Q230P protein would carry WWOX function: there is no per-molecule WWOX function assay in the repository, and protein quantity does not imply function (in the R1 lot quantity and function diverged in some systems and function could not be measured in others).

The share of destabilised-missense lesions that are stability lesions for a WWOX SDR-domain variant: the estimates carried in the literature are cited estimates, and the SDR-domain thermal stability is a missing measurement.
No drug has been given to any WWOX model carrying a missense or a splice allele (known-roads note, section 5).
Whether a cytosolic enzyme lesion behaves like the ER-retained branch at all.
Whether the class, if it acts, acts through chaperoning or through raising expression of the allele.
Whether the class acts on a soluble cytosolic mutant through HDAC6/HSP90 acetylation: butyrate does not engage HDAC6 and no pan-HDAC or HDAC6-selective arm exists in the soluble precedent.

The residual function of the Q230P-class protein per molecule and its amount relative to wild type: the reciprocal of their product is the fold gain any boost would need, and neither factor is measured for any WWOX allele.
Whether any function read-out of WWOX saturates below wild-type protein, as the soluble precedent's read-out appears to.

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

against: Wild type is raised in every target: the effect is not mutant-specific.
Not rescued: the partly trafficked G443D; null zebrafish (protein not measured); butyrate raised total immature protein with a small, variant-dependent function gain.
Mouse exposures were short (days); no brain exposure measured beside mutant protein; the human arm of one paper is one uncontrolled child.
No enzyme-class precedent for the class; the enzyme precedents use degradation blockade or an active-site binder.

The soluble precedent raises wild type as well, adds no enzyme, no route-inhibitor arm and no mRNA under treatment, uses a dominant-negative mechanism WWOX does not have, and its total-protein gain on four of five mutants is only about 1.05 to 1.65 fold.

A required-fold limit: a boost multiplies the mutant's residual function and does not change it; parity needs the reciprocal of (amount times function per molecule), which is unmeasured for every WWOX allele, and observed gains (about 1.05 to 9 fold) also apply to wild type.

The measured turnover difference (about 1.5 to 3 fold) explains only a small part of a 12 to 25 fold steady-state deficit in the soluble precedent, so the 'made then cleared' branch is not the only candidate even where turnover is measured.
for: Allele-specific rescue of a fully ER-retained variant with protein and function read together (GAT-1 G443V, fly seizure-like episodes down).
Total and surface protein rise in other missense lesions with the class.

In the soluble cytosolic client, the class and two HDAC-free osmolytes raised the mutant while a class-I HDAC inhibitor did not, and the soluble fraction roughly doubled with a vesicle-recycling read-out at or above the untreated wild-type range for three of the four low-protein variants (partial dissociation of quantity from function in the favourable direction; NOT WWOX EVIDENCE).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Soluble monomeric client with a dominant-negative mechanism, or ER-retained membrane client, versus a recessive cytosolic SDR enzyme; CMV-promoter plasmid overexpression in cell lines, or lentiviral expression near wild-type level in neurons (authors' statement; saturation or excess not excluded), versus own promoter; wild type raised alike; the in vitro and in vivo gains are protein quantity, not WWOX function.

p4_card.expected_contribution: Function recovery of residual WWOX protein is the only contribution hypothesised; compensation, symptom and protection are not claimed. The branch (retained, cleared, insoluble) must be placed before any contribution can be stated.
p4_card.identity: 4-phenylbutyrate (and the related salt forms) and bile-acid chemical chaperones (e.g. the TUDCA class), taken together because TX-003 lists them together. The two are not interchangeable; the SLC6A1 reading found a similar variant-by-variant pattern only for the bile acid. Formulation relevant to any use: UNKNOWN.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (Q230P-class missense) as target. Origin contexts: STXBP1, SLC6A1, GABRA1 and GAT-1 variants in cells, worm, fly, zebrafish and mouse (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). Bridge limit: one precedent of the lot is a soluble cytosolic client (Munc18-1) where the class raised the mutant, but no enzyme and no WWOX system was tested; wild type is raised as well.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: the folding or trafficking fate of a destabilised client; type of action debated among three non-exclusive classes: physical chemical chaperoning (the class and HDAC-free osmolytes both raised a soluble mutant), HDAC6/HSP90-linked acetylation (open for the class: the class engages HDAC6 at applied levels, butyrate does not, one cytosolic enzyme precedent responds to an HDAC6 lever), and class-I HDAC-mediated transcription of the cDNA (a class-I inhibitor did not reproduce the soluble mutant gain, a contrast that assumes butyrate is at least as strong as the class on class-I enzymes, which is document-dependent; promoter and mRNA-under-treatment controls absent). No source curates a chaperone target or potency for the class; its HDAC potencies are quantified at enzyme level and the applied levels sit well above them. Direction: up in protein; context: ER-retained membrane clients and one soluble cytosolic client.
p4_card.next_measurement: Build the wild-type function ruler first, then fate, then levers. (1) In an isogenic WWOX-null human neural system with one inducible promoter at one landing site, titrate wild-type WWOX across at least five levels and read a WWOX-dependent cell phenotype against measured per-cell protein (Tier 1: glucose uptake or lactate/oxygen consumption, which depends on WW1; Tier 2, binary confirmation only: neuronal Ca2+ firing; design in wwox_function_reference_it6_20261029.md) with antibody blot plus targeted mass spectrometry, soluble, pellet and total fractions, and transgene mRNA in the same wells, with empty/EGFP-null, WW1-dead (W44F/P47A) and isogenic uninduced wild-type arms, and L404A as an SDR-region binding probe only; (2) place the Q230P-class allele on that curve and read a per-molecule binding-competence ratio (WW1-dependent and SDR-region partners) beside it; (3) only then run the three-class lever panel of the IT5 P8 design (class-I HDAC inhibitor without HDAC6 activity; pan-HDAC or HDAC6-selective inhibitor; HDAC-free bile acid and osmolytes with an osmotic control), each also on the null line and on the wild-type ruler line, with the arm-outcome predictions registered in both directions. A result on the Tier 1 curve is read as recovery of the WW1-dependent axis only, not as rescue of SDR-domain function, unless an SDR-region readout also agrees. No abundance gain is read as rescue unless the variant plus compound arm moves along its own ruler curve with mRNA flat and the null line unaffected; a gain at equal protein above the variant's own curve is scored separately as a rise in per-molecule function. No WWOX catalytic activity is assumed or assayed: none is validated.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test in any WWOX system (registry-based, known-roads note section 2.8, 2026-10-20); no dedicated PubMed query for these molecules was run for this card. 4-PBA/TUDCA were carried as TX-003 and withdrawn on rationale (DIS-004), not on a result. NOT MAI_TENTATO-proof: unpublished individual experience is unreachable by any literature query.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.
p4_card.pharmacology: Potency, relevant exposure and selectivity in a WWOX system: UNKNOWN. Re-examined in IT5 (pharmacology_it5_20261029/proteostasis_pba_a01.tsv): the only measured potency for the class is HDAC inhibition, at micromolar to sub-millimolar values (one HeLa extract study: low micromolar; recombinant enzymes: tens to hundreds of micromolar, with butyrate more potent than phenylbutyrate in the same assay and the order reversed in the HeLa study), while the cell experiments in the cited papers applied roughly half a millimolar to ten millimolar for a day (a toxicity ceiling at four millimolar in one paper) and the bile acid one hundred micromolar; so HDAC inhibition is quantitatively available at the concentrations used and cannot be excluded as the operating mechanism, and there is no numeric value for the chaperone mechanism of either compound, although qualitative active records exist for phenylbutyric acid alone (model-protein aggregation suppression and ER-stress cell protection, each at a single concentration and neither on a disease client); the bile acid has no folding or aggregation record In the sources: class not selective for the mutant; brain exposure not measured in any R1 paper. Keyless sources, IT5 P8 re-pull: no folding, binding or thermal-shift datum for the class or TUDCA in ChEMBL, GtoPdb or DGIdb (ChEMBL mechanism of record: ammonia scavenging for the sodium salt, Unknown for TUDCA; GtoPdb no curated interaction for either); the levels applied in cells were about 8 to 78 times the class's HDAC enzyme IC50 (arithmetic, not occupancy); butyrate is 4 to 29 times more potent than the acid on class I in one document (its low values recur in another that lists no phenylbutyrate) but weaker on HDAC1 than the sodium salt in a third, so the relative class-I strength is document-dependent; butyrate does not engage HDAC6 in the one document that tests it.
p4_card.predictions: No engine, no score. The in-silico values recorded in CLAIM 019 are IPOTESI about a folding perturbation of Q230P, not predictions about any drug; they stay IPOTESI.
question_history: TX-003 (proposed), DIS-004 (withdrawn rationale, live revival trigger: HDAC-inhibitor or HSP co-inducer role)
arimoclomol-type co-induction withdrawn the same day (D-03: HSC70 delivers the mutant to the lysosome)
CLAIM 019 / CLAIM 030 / CLAIM 032 (Q230P: rescue conditional on distinguishing synthesis, solubility and turnover and on showing function of the recovered protein)

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: The wrong-compartment transfer objection (INFERENZA); the IT5 P8 additions: the soluble-client contrast, the applied-level arithmetic, the required-fold limit and the panel-reading estimates (reader estimates, INFERENZA, blind audit OWED).
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: R1 readings carry recorded receipts and PASS manifests. The blind audit of six R1 manifests has run (95 triples: 76 supported, 15 overshoot, 2 undershoot, 2 unverifiable; page_adjudications/locator_audit_R1_20261022.md) and its repairs were applied at source; those repairs are not themselves re-audited. This card was audited in page_adjudications/locator_audit_deep_cards_20261022.md; the defects named there are repaired here and the repair is not certified by its author.
scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: Rescue of the retained branch seen in two papers of one target family (GAT-1 variants); no replication in an enzyme-class or WWOX system.

external_not_wwox_evidence: Munc18-1 worm and cell study
GAT-1 and GAT-1 G443 studies
GABRA1 phenylbutyrate mouse study
stxbp1 zebrafish null study
internal: TX-003, DIS-004, D-03 as cited in the known-roads note (arimoclomol-type candidate, withdrawn the same day)

p4_card.state_of_known_roads: inconclusive, narrowed in IT5 P8 (rationale withdrawn once, not refuted; compartment objection not established for a soluble client; no WWOX test; HDAC6 role open).
p4_card.status_reason: Mechanism of the class contested among three classes; rescue allele-specific; rationale withdrawn once and the compartment objection narrowed, not removed; revival trigger partly answered (class-I HDAC action does not reproduce the soluble mutant gain; HDAC6 role open). Deferred until the lesion's fate and a wild-type function ruler exist.
p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. Not documented in the repository.
p4_card.time_to_benefit: UNKNOWN. Not documented; no WWOX datum exists from which to estimate it.
p4_card.value_added: Separates what the class did in other proteins (retained-branch rescue, non-selectivity, non-rescue) from what is unknown for Q230P; corrects the compartment transfer claim (one precedent is a soluble cytosolic client); splits the abundance gain into three mechanistic classes with one measured contrast each; adds the required-fold limit and the arm set the fate experiment needs.

cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Precedents: HEK293/HEK293T, Neuro2a, worm, fly glia, zebrafish larva, knock-in mouse thalamus and cortex. Q230P-relevant neurons and oligodendrocyte-lineage cells: not studied with this class.
cellular_context.coverage: Target expression and drug selectivity are different questions; neither is answered here. The class is not selective (it raises wild-type protein).
cellular_context.limits: WWOX is described here as cytosolic, though its localisation is reported in several compartments and is unmeasured for the Q230P class. The compartment objection that withdrew this class once (DIS-004) is not established for a soluble client: in a soluble cytosolic precedent (Munc18-1) the class and two HDAC-free osmolytes raised the mutant protein while a class-I HDAC inhibitor did not. A role of HDAC6 is open (the comparator does not engage it; no pan-HDAC or HDAC6-selective arm in that paper; a cytosolic enzyme precedent responds to an HDAC6 lever). INFERENZA, blind audit OWED.
cellular_context.target_expression: UNKNOWN for relevant human neural cells and stages; the only Q230P measurement is one patient fibroblast line.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Return of detectable, soluble, functional WWOX protein from a Q230P-class missense lesion; the proximal readout would be total, soluble and pellet WWOX plus a WWOX function assay, none of which exists for this allele.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX. Adjacent precedents measure protein and function together in other proteins and the two come apart in six of them (R1 question 2); no function readout for WWOX is defined in the repository.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Every precedent is an overexpression cell line, a worm, a fly, a zebrafish null or a short mouse exposure. All but one concern membrane or secretory-pathway proteins; the exception, Munc18-1, is a soluble cytosolic protein that is not an enzyme and carries a dominant-negative mechanism. None is an enzyme from its own promoter, none measured transgene mRNA under treatment beside protein, and none measured brain exposure beside mutant-protein level.

cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Precedents: HEK293/HEK293T, Neuro2a, worm, fly glia, zebrafish larva, knock-in mouse thalamus and cortex. Q230P-relevant neurons and oligodendrocyte-lineage cells: not studied with this class.
cellular_context.coverage: Target expression and drug selectivity are different questions; neither is answered here. The class is not selective (it raises wild-type protein).
cellular_context.limits: WWOX is described here as cytosolic, though its localisation is reported in several compartments and is unmeasured for the Q230P class. The compartment objection that withdrew this class once (DIS-004) is not established for a soluble client: in a soluble cytosolic precedent (Munc18-1) the class and two HDAC-free osmolytes raised the mutant protein while a class-I HDAC inhibitor did not. A role of HDAC6 is open (the comparator does not engage it; no pan-HDAC or HDAC6-selective arm in that paper; a cytosolic enzyme precedent responds to an HDAC6 lever). INFERENZA, blind audit OWED.
cellular_context.target_expression: UNKNOWN for relevant human neural cells and stages; the only Q230P measurement is one patient fibroblast line.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Return of detectable, soluble, functional WWOX protein from a Q230P-class missense lesion; the proximal readout would be total, soluble and pellet WWOX plus a WWOX function assay, none of which exists for this allele.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None for WWOX. Adjacent precedents measure protein and function together in other proteins and the two come apart in six of them (R1 question 2); no function readout for WWOX is defined in the repository.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Every precedent is an overexpression cell line, a worm, a fly, a zebrafish null or a short mouse exposure. All but one concern membrane or secretory-pathway proteins; the exception, Munc18-1, is a soluble cytosolic protein that is not an enzyme and carries a dominant-negative mechanism. None is an enzyme from its own promoter, none measured transgene mRNA under treatment beside protein, and none measured brain exposure beside mutant-protein level.

translation.cns_exposure: UNKNOWN. Brain exposure of the class beside mutant-protein level was not measured in any R1 paper.
translation.functional_rescue: UNKNOWN for WWOX. In other proteins protein and function were measured together: partial, non-selective, variant-dependent.
translation.pediatric_suitability: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

evidence_against: Oligodendrocyte-lineage deletion shows no anomaly while neuronal deletion reproduces it.
The oligodendrocyte-promoter AAV arm gave no detectable protein, so it neither supports nor refutes oligodendroglial relevance.
In a seizure network, activity drives maladaptive myelination in the other-disease precedent: suppressing activity may lower or raise myelin depending on the system; the sign here is unmeasured.
Oligodendroglial NMDA receptors support axonal energy metabolism in the other-disease precedent, so chronic NMDAR block (F01) has a myelin-side cost that is unmeasured.
The myelin window closes early.

mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Broad functional recovery would need a developmental endpoint; the strand is held at abstention because no drug has been applied to a Wwox system for any myelin endpoint and the sign of the activity-myelin relationship in this genotype is unmeasured.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class

input.no_new_reading: W2 (scientist-c, 2026-10-27): no new full-text receipt; first-hand re-reads of already-receipted papers and of open PubMed Central text are described in the W2 record.
not_known: Whether activity raises or lowers myelin in the Wwox-deficient brain.
Whether any pro-myelinating agent acts on Wwox-deficient oligodendrocytes.
The quantified MBP or g-ratio after neuronal AAV rescue.
Whether an oligodendroglial WWOX function exists under remyelination stress.

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

against: Oligodendrocyte-lineage deletion shows no anomaly while neuronal deletion reproduces it.
The oligodendrocyte-promoter AAV arm gave no detectable protein, so it neither supports nor refutes oligodendroglial relevance.
In a seizure network, activity drives maladaptive myelination in the other-disease precedent: suppressing activity may lower or raise myelin depending on the system; the sign here is unmeasured.
Oligodendroglial NMDA receptors support axonal energy metabolism in the other-disease precedent, so chronic NMDAR block (F01) has a myelin-side cost that is unmeasured.
The myelin window closes early.
for: Myelin is reduced in the knockout and activity-dependent myelination exists in other systems.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Absence-seizure and healthy-brain systems; adult versus neonatal; no Wwox arm.

p4_card.identity: Pro-myelinating agents (muscarinic-antagonist class such as clemastine and benztropine, thyroid-hormone and antipsychotic routes) and, as a separate question, activity manipulation as a myelin lever.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the Wwox-deficient oligodendrocyte lineage is itself the limiting compartment, which the neuron-versus-oligodendrocyte genetic arms argue against. Transfer unmeasured.
p4_card.mechanism: Target (if pursued): oligodendrocyte differentiation or the axon-oligodendrocyte activity signal. Direction wanted: more compact myelin. The causal compartment is neuronal, so a drug acting on oligodendrocytes alone is not expected to reach the cause.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-null (or conditional neuronal) mice or co-cultures; arms: vehicle, chronic activity suppression, activity-raising manipulation, one pro-myelinating agent; controls: wild type with the same arms, neuronal-restoration positive control; endpoints: quantified MBP and g-ratio by electron microscopy, oligodendrocyte counts; discriminating result: the direction of the myelin change under suppression versus under activity.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: N-13 stands. New: the earlier record (DL-MECH-031 point 2) proposed that reducing seizure load might itself improve myelination because myelination is activity-dependent. The best-matched non-WWOX datum points the other way for a seizing network: Knowles 2022, Nat Neurosci (PMID 35501379, abstract read; absence-seizure models, not WWOX) reports that seizure-driven activity increases oligodendrogenesis and myelination in the seizure network, is prevented by seizure suppression, and that blocking activity-dependent myelination lowers seizure burden. The Wwox-null brain is hypomyelinated despite bursting, so neither simple sign is established. Also found: the 'near-complete MBP rescue' of the neuronal AAV is image-only (DA-W2-011).
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE if ever; broad recovery needs the developmental endpoint.
p4_card.pharmacology: Not assessed: no compound is carded.
p4_card.predictions: Registered: if hypomyelination is driven by loss of an axonal signal, an oligodendrocyte-directed compound leaves it unchanged in Wwox-deficient neurons and corrects it only after neuronal restoration; if activity raises myelin in this genotype, chronic suppression lowers MBP; if activity suppression helps, MBP rises. The three outcomes are separable by one chronic-suppression arm and one activity-raising arm against vehicle.

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: Every statement marked INFERENZA, and every card-level synthesis, is owed a blind audit by someone other than the producer.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Breton rows carry verbatim locators in the manifest (receipt FTR-20260810-34634460-02); the n values of the d-APV arm and the mEPSC text were re-read first-hand from the shared full-text XML on 2026-10-27 without a new receipt. GRIN and rat rows are at the reading depth stated per row.
scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory for every WWOX row used here; no independent replication.

external_not_wwox_evidence: Knowles 2022 Nat Neurosci (PMID 35501379), abstract only
Saab 2016 Neuron (PMID 27292539), title only: oligodendroglial NMDA receptors and axonal energy metabolism

p4_card.value_added: Records that the seizure-load-improves-myelin inference was an assumption with a counter-precedent, and that the neuronal rescue's myelin evidence is image-level.

cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: in-vivo mouse white matter for the disease rows.
cellular_context.limits: Myelin is measured as MBP image intensity; the treated-arm quantification does not exist.
cellular_context.target_expression: Oligodendrocyte-lineage transcripts are barely detectable in the week-15 organoid.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: A myelin endpoint with a quantified treated arm in a Wwox-deficient system (MBP or g-ratio by electron microscopy, oligodendrocyte counts) after a pro-myelinating agent, after chronic activity suppression, and after an activity-raising manipulation, each against a Wwox-deficient vehicle arm.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: Neuron-specific, not oligodendrocyte-specific, Wwox loss reproduces the hypomyelination (genetic evidence of the earlier mouse work, PMID 34268881 manifest); neuronal gene replacement is reported to restore MBP by image. No pro-myelinating compound has been given to any Wwox system.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Mouse, early postnatal window; the AAV rescue works to the earliest days tested and later ages were not testable in the null.

p4_roadmap_fields.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the Wwox-deficient oligodendrocyte lineage is itself the limiting compartment, which the neuron-versus-oligodendrocyte genetic arms argue against. Transfer unmeasured.

label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.

mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; the only synonym-driven record is one observational natural-history registry. Carried with the census's own caution: "A missing hit does not prove that no study exists." It answers seven queries against one registry on one date; unregistered, differently worded, non-NLM or later-registered studies are not excluded.

against: Not independently replicated within the repository; the source's mouse-versus-human construct comparison is an intra-study control, and the human-organoid source was not tested here.

SURVIVAL IS A STEP IN THESE DATA, BUT A STEP AND A STEEP CONTINUUM ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE: the lower level postpones death and reaches extinction; two dose points cannot locate a threshold; the adjudication in CLAIM 011 reads the step as strengthened, not established.
Body weight is equal at the two levels at one age and the weight comparison is survivor-conditioned on the lower side: an equality between unequal denominators is not evidence of grading.
Myelination dose relation never quantified; gliosis result binary against wild type with no untreated-null comparator; SWD has no low-level arm.
No tumour surveillance of any kind in a pro-apoptotic tumour suppressor delivered irreversibly; no measured ceiling.
Treatment age window tested only at the earliest postnatal ages; later NOT_MEASURED.
Behaviour at 3 months has no untreated-null arm by construction and a text-versus-panel conflict, not adjudicated.
for: SWD to a level not distinguishable from wild type in the strongest causal design of the corpus (blinded; single vector level).
Durable survival to 300 days at the higher vector level, comparable to the wild-type arm (which itself lost about 29 percent).
Graded WWOX protein, glycaemia at one age and motor score.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Null versus missense or compound context; mouse absence-type SWD versus human convulsive repertoire.

p4_card.expected_contribution: Early-window restoration by replacement (early-window benefit demonstrated in the null mouse; recovery after onset not tested); nothing is stated for clinical benefit.
p4_card.identity: AAV9 carrying human WWOX cDNA under a neuronal promoter, with and without a post-transcriptional element; the promoter-comparison constructs are a different architecture. Whether any programme's clinical construct equals the mouse-study construct: UNKNOWN. Titre convention is undeclared by the source and no vector quantity is reproduced here.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WOREE (all genotypes carry some level of WWOX deficit) as target; origin: a constitutive-null mouse and human knockout and patient-derived organoids. Transfer to a Q230P-class missense or compound context is not established.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: WWOX gene dosage in neurons; type: replacement; direction: protein up; context: null mouse brain.
p4_card.next_measurement: An intermediate-level arm, defined as a fraction of the primary's higher level (never in absolute quantity), carried to 300 days with survival, weight, glycaemia, ECoG and quantified myelin in the same animals; and an independent replication. Either would change whether this is a threshold or a steep continuum.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied (two mouse papers, one laboratory). A gene-therapy programme for WOREE is recorded at grant level (census § 3); that is not a registered study.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.
p4_card.pharmacology: Not applicable in the small-molecule sense: biodistribution regionally uneven; potency, selectivity and CNS exposure of a human product: UNKNOWN. The absolute vector quantity is uncertain by exactly a factor of two in the source and no figure is reproduced.

p4_card.time_to_access: UNKNOWN. The census records a programme with a gene-therapy objective at grant level; no registered WOREE study; sponsor-declared authorisation, enrolment and first dose UNKNOWN.
p4_card.time_to_benefit: UNKNOWN in humans. In the mouse the SWD effect was recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; no earlier ECoG timepoint exists.
p4_card.value_added: Shows which endpoints carry a graded relation and which do not, so a single useful endpoint is not read as a dose-response.

cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: Mouse brain regions; the cerebellum, the organ of the ataxic phenotype, is the region the vector reaches least and no efficacy endpoint was measured there; protein also reaches the sciatic nerve while liver stays at background.
cellular_context.coverage: Oligodendrocyte-directed construct produced essentially no detectable protein, so the oligodendrocyte question is unanswered, not answered negatively.
cellular_context.limits: Residual partial function in a missense context is a reason to expect a DIFFERENT result, not a larger one; the expected level of rescue in the reference genotype does not follow from this study in either direction.
cellular_context.target_expression: Neuron-directed construct; WWOX protein graded by vector level and regionally uneven, supraphysiological in survivors and survivor-selected (PREMISE: NOBODY_LOOKED on the upper bound).

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: Early-window restoration of WWOX function (before the start of ECoG recording at about P14; phenotype onset never located) by neuron-directed replacement; the single useful endpoint carried is spike-wave discharge rate. Other measured families (survival, growth and glycaemia, motor score, myelination, gliosis) are in p4_card and are NOT compared by the bridge, which holds one disease assertion per packet. SWD rate is read after neonatal treatment of animals never recorded before it; it is a prevention or early-window readout.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: In the Wwox-null mouse, by one laboratory: SWD rate to wild-type level (single vector level); survival to 300 days at the higher vector level; a graded motor score; graded glycaemia at one age; WWOX protein graded; myelination qualitative only; gliosis binary against wild type with no untreated-null comparator in the quantified treated panels.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: Constitutive null, not Q230P; one laboratory (the two papers share senior author and institution); no replication; earliest postnatal treatment ages only and NOT_MEASURED is not SMALLER; no tumour surveillance or overexpression-toxicity endpoint; SWD recorded over one week starting about two weeks after birth; threshold not located. Every endpoint is measured after neonatal treatment (P0 to P5) in animals that were never measured before treatment: the result is PREVENTION or EARLY-WINDOW, not recovery of a manifested deficit. No treated-after-onset arm exists; the authors state later intervention 'was not explored' and that this reflects 'model-specific biological constraints and technical limitations, rather than a definitive boundary'.

Dependence of bursting on NMDAR activity is permissive: it does not show that NMDAR function is raised; no NMDAR current or subunit was measured.

evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Juvenile slice, one laboratory, knockout not allele; chronic NMDAR or AMPAR blockade in a developing brain also acts on activity-dependent maturation, including myelination (see F02).

p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. At best a reduction of a network state; no developmental benefit is implied.
p4_card.identity: Memantine (approved, uncompetitive NMDAR pore blocker; paediatric safety and effectiveness not established on its label) and perampanel (approved, non-competitive AMPAR antagonist; paediatric label for partial-onset seizures). Tool compounds: d-APV. Both are symptomatic-network levers on one measured phenotype, not WWOX restoration.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF the neuron-specific Wwox bursting phenotype is driven by a measurable gain in glutamatergic transmission that a partial block of NMDAR or AMPAR corrects without harming activity-dependent maturation. Transfer to the reference genotype is unmeasured for both alleles: the slice model is a Synapsin-Cre knockout, not a missense or splice allele.
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: NMDAR (GRIN1 with GRIN2A/2B/2D) and AMPAR (GRIA1-4). Direction wanted: lower excitatory gain. Context: juvenile neocortical slice, neuron-specific knockout. Memantine is a use-dependent pore blocker with subunit-dependent, assay-dependent potency; d-APV is a competitive full block: the tool result does not transfer quantitatively to the drug.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-deficient versus parental or isogenic neurons or slices; graded memantine versus perampanel versus d-APV; controls: wild type, heterozygote, vehicle, washout, an NMDAR-selective and an AMPAR-selective evoked-current check to define which receptor is raised (NMDA:AMPA ratio under voltage control, not the mEPSC decay); endpoints: burst frequency, duration, amplitude, phase-amplitude coupling, then a maturation endpoint; discriminating result: a partial block that abolishes bursting in knockout and spares wild-type activity versus one that does not.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Memantine on the NMDAR node is already map record R-02 (class PROMISING_BUT_MECHANISTIC_GAP). New here: (1) the sign of the receptor lesion decides memantine's response in the one genetic-NMDAR cohort that stratified by function, so the 'GRIN2A corroborates the node' argument (DL-MECH-002) corroborates the node, not the sign; (2) the AMPAR arm, never carried as a node, rests on the only direct synaptic measurement in the knockout (raised mEPSC amplitude), and is untested. Coverage: PubMed searches of 2026-10-27 (GRIN-memantine, neonatal memantine, WWOX myelin), the Karnstedt full text, the repository's perampanel notes; NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA for any memantine or perampanel arm in a Wwox model, not MAI_TENTATO.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: Memantine label: paediatric safety and effectiveness not established; two controlled paediatric autism studies failed. Perampanel label: partial-onset seizures from 4 years of age. Interactions and labelled warnings were NOT assessed (adapter sections lacked them). No paediatric suitability for WWOX-DEE is presumed.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A; Track B untested.
p4_card.pharmacology: Memantine: use-dependent channel blocker; recorded potency depends on voltage, magnesium and agonist level and spans several orders of magnitude across assays (README section 4). Perampanel: non-competitive AMPAR antagonist. CNS exposure for both is expected from their indications but is not verified here for the slice-relevant free fraction.
p4_card.predictions: Registered before any experiment: (a) if bursting reflects raised NMDAR function, a partial memantine exposure lowers burst frequency in knockout slices dose-dependently and not in wild type; (b) if it reflects raised AMPAR gain, perampanel does and memantine less; (c) if both are permissive routes of a network that recruits NMDAR, only the full block works and neither drug is a lever. Result (c) closes the strand.

evidence_against: SPECIFICITY FAILED: lithium suppressed the provoked seizure in all three genotypes, wild type included (Figure 7d; entries 0, 22).

The causal attribution to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone; the paper's own Discussion names lithium's other documented actions, including Wnt/beta-catenin-dependent effects (entry 3). Lithium acts on many targets besides GSK3beta.

The only cell-line source (Wang 2012, PMID 22193544) reports Ser9 phosphorylation unchanged during retinoic-acid differentiation of SH-SY5Y cells, while WWOX rose (entry 5): that is a WWOX-gain, differentiation context, not a WWOX-loss measurement, and must not be read as a knockdown result; the knockdown experiment of that paper measured Tau phosphorylation (entry 8), not Ser9.
Direction conflict (INFERENZA): beta-catenin stabilisation by lithium would push an axis that is already raised in WWOX-loss organoids (map record R-04, axis M5; card P4-D-02).
Different control groups and schedules for lithium and ethosuximide inside one figure (entries 27, 28): the two drugs are not compared on equal terms.
A clinical anticonvulsant effect would be symptomatic: CLAIM 031 states that seizure control does not buy development.

mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Symptomatic seizure suppression in a provoked-seizure assay; not WWOX-specific (wild type responds). Not deep recovery; WWOX function would remain lost. Track B: no allele-specific datum.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery
mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class

input.no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card. Every locator is an existing entry of the deep-dive manifests PMID32000863.json and PMID22193544.json; the figure statements are those entries' own.
not_known: Whether lithium does anything in a Wwox-deficient system that it does not do in a wild-type one (the one experiment that tested it answered no).
Whether lithium moves GSK3beta Ser9 phosphorylation or kinase activity in a Wwox-null brain: lithium's effect on the Ser9 readout was not measured in this system.

Whether GSK3beta abundance or Ser9 state tracks activity here: abundance and activity are dissociable in this very system (S9-independent inhibition), and no kinase-activity assay exists in a WWOX system.
Whether the null-genotype hypersusceptibility is a driver of the developmental phenotype or an amplifier on a malformed brain (entry 6).
Whether the wild-type response is floor-limited in a way that hides a genotype difference.
Any allele-specific datum (Q230P class or splice allele): none exists for lithium.
Net direction on the Wnt axis: lithium stabilises beta-catenin, and WWOX-loss organoids show nuclear beta-catenin already raised (card P4-D-02).

p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

against: SPECIFICITY FAILED: lithium suppressed the provoked seizure in all three genotypes, wild type included (Figure 7d; entries 0, 22).

The causal attribution to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone; the paper's own Discussion names lithium's other documented actions, including Wnt/beta-catenin-dependent effects (entry 3). Lithium acts on many targets besides GSK3beta.

The only cell-line source (Wang 2012, PMID 22193544) reports Ser9 phosphorylation unchanged during retinoic-acid differentiation of SH-SY5Y cells, while WWOX rose (entry 5): that is a WWOX-gain, differentiation context, not a WWOX-loss measurement, and must not be read as a knockdown result; the knockdown experiment of that paper measured Tau phosphorylation (entry 8), not Ser9.
Direction conflict (INFERENZA): beta-catenin stabilisation by lithium would push an axis that is already raised in WWOX-loss organoids (map record R-04, axis M5; card P4-D-02).
Different control groups and schedules for lithium and ethosuximide inside one figure (entries 27, 28): the two drugs are not compared on equal terms.
A clinical anticonvulsant effect would be symptomatic: CLAIM 031 states that seizure control does not buy development.
for: Lithium suppressed the provoked seizure score in the null genotype (Figure 7d, null panel).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Engineered null mouse versus a missense or compound human context; a provoked-seizure score in preweaning pups versus a human epilepsy; one laboratory.

p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN beyond non-specific seizure suppression; direction on the Wnt axis possibly adverse (INFERENZA).
p4_card.identity: Lithium (the salt used in the mouse experiment: lithium chloride; the clinical compound class is lithium carbonate), used in the one WWOX experiment as a tool inhibitor of GSK3beta. Map records R-04 (repurposing) and N-02 (negative translation) describe the same candidate and are linked to this one card.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Symptomatic seizure suppression is the only endpoint ever tested in a WWOX system; it is non-specific (wild type responds equally). A WWOX-specific disease-modifying rationale is not supported by the primary data. Transfer to the reference genotype: not established.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: GSK3beta (among many); claimed: inhibits a kinase de-repressed by WWOX loss; the de-repression is read from a single Ser9 phosphorylation blot; the attribution of the seizure effect to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone.
p4_card.next_measurement: A provoked-seizure arm with an explicit, tested null versus wild-type contrast and the interaction reported, or a different GSK3beta inhibitor under the same design; and a kinase-activity or substrate-phosphorylation readout in a Wwox-null system. Until then no genotype-specific claim is available.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied once (Cheng 2020, one laboratory, one experiment). Not new; the question is whether the result means what it was read as meaning.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A (allele-blind); not deep recovery.
p4_card.pharmacology: Approved compound (class level, from map record R-04) with a narrow therapeutic index and monitoring needs; CNS exposure is not in doubt. Nothing here is a statement about exposure in WWOX-DEE.

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: The direction-conflict statement on the Wnt axis and the amplifier-not-driver reading are INFERENZA and are owed a blind audit by another actor.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: The lithium figure panels were read from the image; the 2026-10-21 R2 figure readings (entries 27, 28) carry a blind locator audit (SUPPORTED) and a recorded softening of wording; the null-only wording of the Results text against the three-panel figure is a recorded text-versus-panel finding.
scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory, one experiment; no replication.

p4_card.state_of_known_roads: Map R-04 class DEPRIORITIZE; N-02 negative translation; CLAIM 016, CLAIM 035, PAPER 019, PAPER 056; known-roads reconnaissance of 2026-10-20.
p4_card.status_reason: The one experiment failed its specificity test and the Wnt-axis direction may be adverse.
p4_card.value_added: Keeps the lithium result as what it is (non-specific symptomatic suppression, specificity failed) so it is not read as a WWOX-specific signal, and names the contrast that would change that.
